text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian negotiator Saeb Erekat and Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali agree on need for Israel to implement its commitments.
- Ministry of Supply is inclined towards gradual liberalisation of fruit and vegetable prices, sources say.
- Reward offered for information about arson attack on car belonging to former security chief investigating shooting of Israeli schoolgirls.
- First Palestinian flights, two planes chartered to take West Bank students to Morocco, will arrive in Amman today.
- Jordan air transport officials says Iraq didn't ask permission for Iraqi plane to overfly its territory on the way to Saudi Arabia and didn't show up on its radar.
- Crown Prince calls on youth to help in national construction and stability.
